__comment: SYNTHETIC, PARAMETERIZED TARGET board (issue #58). Versioned here as the target schema. title: Aegis · Connector & Telemetry Freshness
description: TARGET board — requires the #86 telemetry-export path. Reads the intended custom table WpConnectorFetch_CL (Connector_s, Success_b, TimeGenerated), which is not emitted yet, so this board fails at query time until #86 lands. Versioned as the target schema.

list.name: subscription
list.label: Subscription
list.description: Deploy-time: set to the in-boundary subscription id (never committed).

list.name: workspace
list.label: Log Analytics workspace (resource id)
list.description: Deploy-time: set to the in-boundary Log Analytics workspace resource id (from deploy outputs).

list.name: connector
list.label: Connector
list.description: Read-only edge connectors. Aggregate freshness only — no payloads.

panels.title: Seconds since last successful fetch (per connector)
panels.description: Staleness per connector. Aggregate lag only — no fetched content is shown. Fail-closed: a missing connector row means unverified, not fresh.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Synthetic aggregate query — table name is a placeholder, rebind at provision time.
WpConnectorFetch_CL
| where Connector_s in (${connector:singlequote})
| where Success_b == true
| summarize LastOk = max(TimeGenerated) by Connector = Connector_s
| extend LagSeconds = datetime_diff('second', now(), LastOk)

panels.title: Fetch success ratio over time
panels.description: Ratio of successful to total fetches per interval. Aggregate ratio only.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
WpConnectorFetch_CL
| where Connector_s in (${connector:singlequote})
| summarize Ok = countif(Success_b == true), Total = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend SuccessRatio = todouble(Ok) / Total
| project TimeGenerated, SuccessRatio
